thread:
maria_cs: Hey team — BrightFund contacted us: after today's inference tuning swap they report a clear increase in confidently wrong answers (fabricated partner names, invented contract clauses). They compared outputs from the previous model and say v2.6 is more assertive. They flagged it as impacting production responses (some users see incorrect legal/partner details).

ops-bot: Deploy: rollout completed: model=redwood-2.6-opt quant_variant=int8-swap canary=100% at 2026-03-17T14:22:03Z (deploy_id: deploy_2056780000) :white_check_mark:

raj_prod: thanks. can you paste a minimal repro from the customer (prompt + model output + request id)? is this across multiple endpoints (chat/completions/structured)?

maria_cs: pasted from BrightFund support ticket (they gave explicit consent to debug):
```json
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-2.6-opt",
  "input": "List the official partners of Acme Healthcare in 2024.",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 120
}
```
Customer received:
"Acme Healthcare official partners: MedAxis, Novacare, HealthBridge."
(not true — customer asserts those are fabricated; they provided request_id `req_9a8b7c6d`, response status 200, latency ~120ms)

maria_cs: They also ran the same prompt against our prior pinned model (v2.5) and got: "I don't have a definitive list of partners for Acme Healthcare in 2024. You should check their official site." — so behavior regressed from cautious -> assertive.

eli_research: thanks. important to know whether the int8 quant variant swapped in has any known calibration drift. please share model_version (full sha) and whether reranker/citation pipeline was active. also can we get a few more failing prompts? ideally 5-10 to add to eval.

sarah_eng: did routing change? we recently enabled cost-preferring routing to int8 variants for several customers to reduce unit cost. if requests are being routed to a different kernel selection path that could impact logit calibration. can you confirm `X-Model-Override` header or the exact model returned in the response JSON? also send the full request HTTP headers (no auth token) and the raw response body if available.

maria_cs: customer provided one more example where the model invents a regulatory clause when asked to summarize a press release. they used chat endpoint as well. they attached the raw response body and headers; I sanitized and uploaded to private ticket.

raj_prod: provisional plan: 1) repro locally against the exact quant variant (int8-swap) using the same low-temp (0.0) settings, 2) run the same prompts against v2.5 and v2.6 float baseline, 3) if reproduced, temporarily route customer back to v2.5 or enforce float path for them.

eli_research: I'll spin up an experiment. can you run the following quickly and paste output?
```
# repro script (internal)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Debug: true" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.6-opt","input":"List the official partners of Acme Healthcare in 2024.","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":120}'
```
Include the `X-Model-Returned` header from the response if present.

sarah_eng: if we confirm quantization impacts calibration, short-term mitigation is to prefer `redwood-2.6-float` for enterprise customers flagged as sensitive. Longer term we need a calibration/regression test that runs on quant variants during deploys.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-205678 - "Model output regression (hallucination) after quant variant swap". Severity: P2. Linked to deploy_2056780000.

raj_prod: marking for eng-ml triage. maria, can you ask BrightFund for permission to share logs + failing prompts with eng-ml? also ask whether they saw the issue before today at lower rate.

maria_cs: on it — asked for permission and for 5-10 failing prompts. BrightFund agreed to share logs under NDA. I'll attach them to the incident once I have raw responses.

eli_research: once we have the prompts I'll add them to the regression harness and run head-to-head on int8 vs float. if reproduced I'll open a bug with a reproducer and propose rolling back the quant routing for affected customers.

sarah_eng: noted. I'll also add a short-term router flag to prefer float for customers with `sensitivity: high`. We should also add this class of prompt to the automatic quality monitor.

maria_cs: summary/next steps for CS: 1) collect full raw responses and headers from BrightFund (they will share), 2) attach to INC-205678, 3) route BrightFund to v2.5/float until resolved, 4) update customer with ETA.

raj_prod: thanks team. keep updates in INC-205678 and post any reproductions here. :pray:
